description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel library, specifically testing paragraph rendering, line spacing, page breaks, borders, and other paragraph-related behaviors within PDFs.

classes.name: ParagraphTests
classes.description: A test suite class using Xunit to verify various paragraph rendering scenarios in PDF documents generated by MigraDoc.

methods.name: ParagraphTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing test setup and resetting PDFSharpCore settings.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Resets PdfSharpCore after tests are run.

methods.name: Test_Empty_Paragraph
methods.description: Tests rendering of an empty paragraph in a document.

methods.name: Test_Empty_FormattedText
methods.description: Tests rendering of a paragraph with empty formatted text.

methods.name: Test_Multiline_Border_Paragraph_PageBreaks
methods.description: Creates multiple documents with a border paragraph that spans multiple pages and forces page breaks at various offsets.

methods.name: Test_Trailing_Objects_Border_Paragraph_PageBreak
methods.description: Tests handling of border paragraphs ending with various trailing objects that previously caused exceptions.

methods.name: Test_LineSpacingRule
methods.description: Verifies correct rendering of different line spacing rules, measuring spacing between text lines in the resulting PDF.

methods.name: Test_PageBreak_And_Fitting_Line_Height
methods.description: Tests proper page breaking with a paragraph containing multiple formatted texts with different sizes.

methods.name: Test_Line_And_PageBreak_Big_Words
methods.description: Tests paragraph rendering with long words that cause line breaks and verifies no unwanted empty lines.
